description: This file defines a React component for a menu system, including a Menu component that handles rendering a menu button, popover menu, and modal menu for mobile views. It manages menu open/close states, accessibility attributes, and interactions with external modal and theme systems.

methods.name: handleMenuClose
methods.description: Handles closing the menu when backdrop is clicked or escape key pressed.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Callback to close the menu, used internally and passed to context.

methods.name: handleMenuModalClose
methods.description: Closes the modal menu and resets anchor element.

methods.name: handleMenuClick
methods.description: Stops propagation of click events within the menu.

methods.name: handleMenuKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard interactions for menu navigation and closing.

methods.name: handleMenuButtonClick
methods.description: Handles click on menu button, opens modal on mobile or sets anchor for popover.

methods.name: renderMenuButton
methods.description: Constructs the menu button element, with optional tooltip.

methods.name: handleModalClickCapture
methods.description: Handles clicks within modal to determine if menu should close.

methods.name: handleKeydown
methods.description: Handles keydown events within modal for accessibility.
